_why: Light body warmth system (R32): slow drift toward ambient target, fire/camp/indoors/clothing protection, and gentle penalties that never kill quickly.
_why_curve: 50 = comfy at 18 C; each degree shifts target by 1.1 points; follow_rate 0.01/s takes minutes rather than seconds to drift into Cold; sun peaks at 14:00 and bottoms at 04:00.

sources._why: Warmth sources pull the target back toward 50: campfire adds +35 up to a cozy 55 cap, camp +20, indoors +15, insulation x30 against cold only, sun_protection x25 against heat only.

thresholds._why: State bands: Freezing < 15 <= Cold < 35 <= Comfy <= 65 < Hot <= 85 < Overheated.

effects._why: Cold slows stamina; Freezing drains 0.25 HP/s but stops at 10 HP so cold alone never kills; Hot and Overheated raise thirst.

weather_offset_c._why: Ambient Celsius offsets scaled by active weather intensity: rain/snow chill by -3 C, fog by -1 C, sandstorms trap +2 C heat.
